title: Playlist Promo on Market Coverage
summary: A small, warm comment section: long-time followers welcome the move into market coverage and say they trust the voice enough to follow it from geography to geopolitics to markets. The useful signals are few but clear: start with the basics because many viewers do not know market concepts, stop using AI-made thumbnails, and cover the BRICS summit. One viewer asks for Hindi.
summary_hi: कमेंट कम हैं पर बहुत अपनापन भरे हैं: पुराने दर्शक मार्केट कवरेज की नई शुरुआत का स्वागत कर रहे हैं और कहते हैं कि वे इस आवाज़ पर भरोसा करके जियोग्राफी से जियोपॉलिटिक्स और अब मार्केट तक साथ आए हैं। काम की बातें थोड़ी हैं पर साफ़ हैं: पहले बेसिक्स समझाइए क्योंकि कई दर्शकों को मार्केट की बुनियादी बातें नहीं पता, AI से बने थंबनेल बंद कीजिए, और BRICS समिट पर वीडियो बनाइए। एक दर्शक ने हिंदी में वीडियो की माँग की है।

themes.label: Loyalty and thanks
themes.note: Thank-yous, love from Bihar and Assam, and followers of many years who trust the voice and the teaching.

themes.label: Waiting for the market series
themes.note: Viewers say they are ready and eager for the analysis, and one wants a video every day.

themes.label: Requests for what to cover
themes.note: Start from market basics, cover the BRICS summit, keep the depth, show how markets and geopolitics connect, and offer Hindi.

themes.label: AI thumbnails
themes.note: Two viewers dislike the AI-made thumbnails and prefer the ones he makes himself.

themes.label: Surprise at the new direction
themes.note: A fan jokes about the channel moving into markets, while still loving the content.

comments.author: @n71169
comments.text: Many people do not understand the basic concept itself, so you can start giving the overview of basics so that we can understand the current market trends easily
comments.highlight: start giving the overview of basics
comments.why: The audience came for geography and geopolitics, so a basics-first opener decides whether they can follow the market playlist at all.
comments.reply: Good point. I will open the playlist with the basics, so the trend videos are easy to follow for everyone.

comments.text: Great sir but don’t use AI Thumbnails as the ones u make are awesome!

comments.reply: Noted, thank you for saying it plainly. I will go back to making the thumbnails myself.

comments.reply: The BRICS summit is on my list, and reading the leaders' gestures and intentions is a good angle for it.
